title: Examples
lead: Complete apps made with Skein UI, each a project of its own with the source on GitHub: read one to see how the components, the theme styles and the CLI's project fit together.

mail.title: Skein Mail
mail.p1: It is the `admin` template of the [Skein CLI](/cli) with a mailbox on top. Every screen is made of existing Skein UI components; nothing was added to the library for it.
mail.p2: It is an example of the interface, not a mail server: the API is answered in the browser by MSW, so it runs with no backend and keeps nothing between reloads. [Live demo](https://skein-mail.skeinui.com) · [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/skeinui/skein-mail).

shows.title: What it shows
shows.menu: Mailboxes in the menu: Inbox, Drafts, Sent, Archive, Junk, Trash
shows.menuHow: One page directory with a `_meta.ts` each, so the menu, the tabs and KeepAlive come from the admin shell.
shows.list: Message list and reader side by side
shows.composeHow: `Drawer`, `Field`, `Input`, `Textarea` and `Upload`; a draft opens again and is replaced when saved or sent.
shows.query: Search, filters and paging over one standard query
shows.queryHow: A `ListQuery` (mailbox, unread and starred are conditions of its filter), answered by the mock with `applyListQuery`.
shows.themes: Four theme styles, light and dark, Chinese and English
shows.themesHow: The [theme styles](/theming) of `@skeinui/themes`, picked in the preferences drawer and loaded only when used.

run.title: Running it
run.p1: Sign in with `admin` / `admin123`; the app opens on the Inbox.

built.title: How it was made
built.p1: The project came from the CLI:
built.p2: Its `src/pages/mail/` holds the mailbox (API types, the mock and its 240 seeded messages, the components, the messages in both languages); the six mailboxes are six routes of one page. Read it next to the [Skein CLI](/cli) guide to see what each part of a generated project is for.

admin.title: Skein Admin
admin.p1: It is the `admin` template of the [Skein CLI](/cli) with pages on top: Orders and Products made by `skein new page --from` out of an OpenAPI document, Users, Reports and a System group. Every screen is made of existing Skein UI components.
admin.p2: It is an example of the interface, not a product: the API is answered in the browser by MSW, so it runs with no backend and keeps nothing between reloads. [Live demo](https://skein-admin.skeinui.com) · [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/skeinui/skein-admin).

shows.title: What it shows
shows.shell: The admin shell: side menu, header, tabs, breadcrumb, preferences drawer
shows.shellHow: `AdminLayout`, `PageTabs`, `Breadcrumb` and `KeepAlive`, wired to the router in `src/skein-shell/`.
shows.tenants: Tenants: every page is under one (`/acme/orders`), a switcher by the logo
shows.tenantsHow: A `$tenant` layout route sets the tenant; requests send it as `X-Tenant-Id`; each tenant has its own query cache.
shows.accessHow: `Access` for buttons, `requireAccess` for a page's door and the 403 page; the API gives the user's permission codes.
shows.lists: Lists that search: Orders and Products
shows.listsHow: `QueryBuilder` chips, `TableTools`, sortable `Table` headers, CSV export; requests are a `ListQuery`, answered by the mock with `applyListQuery`.
shows.login: Sign-in in three looks, switchable on the page
shows.loginHow: The library's `LoginLayout`: split, centered and cover.

built.title: How it was made
built.p1: The project came from the CLI:
built.p2: Each page is a directory of `src/pages/` with its route, API, mock and messages, so the pages made by `skein new page` look like the ones written by hand. Read it next to the [Skein CLI](/cli) guide to see what each part of a generated project is for.
